test_purposes.xyflow-4991-focus-scroll-01: At maximum zoom, tabbing from a visible node to an off-screen node must leave the wrapper scroll offset and React Flow transform unchanged.
test_purposes.xyflow-4991-focus-scroll-02: At maximum zoom, directly calling element.focus() on an off-screen node must leave the wrapper scroll offset and React Flow transform unchanged.
test_purposes.xyflow-4991-focus-scroll-03: The viewport-stability fix must preserve native wrapper scroll delivery to the public onScroll callback, including its target and currentTarget semantics.
